method.capture: Direct top-level navigation; native PerformanceObserver instantiated in the sampled document
method.observationWindowNote: The snapshot is taken 5000 ms after the QA sensor executes, not exactly 5000 ms after navigation. Buffered native LCP/CLS entries precede sensor execution where supported.
method.cacheNote: No forced cache clearing or isolated cold/warm profiles. All app resource transferSize entries are nonzero in these samples; this does not establish a controlled cold-cache run.
method.scope: Three homepage locales at two viewport sizes. Not a performance audit of all 99 content routes.

units.encodedBodyBytes: Native Navigation Timing encodedBodySize plus same-origin Resource Timing encodedBodySize; /__qa/ requests excluded.
units.transferBytes: Native Navigation Timing transferSize plus same-origin Resource Timing transferSize; /__qa/ requests excluded. Includes headers as reported by Chromium.
units.staticGzipBytes: Sum of node:zlib gzipSync output for the exact initial modern JS or linked CSS files, counted once per URL. Separate from browser native encoding.

privateInstrumentation.qualityProbeLoaderNote: QualityProbe client code remains in the shared layout chunk and in the reported 151448-byte initial JS inventory. No arbitrary shared-chunk subtraction is made.
privateInstrumentation.sensorRequestCondition: Local hostname plus one of the six explicit qa profile query values. Ordinary visits do not request the external sensor or append its result panel.
privateInstrumentation.outputPanelTiming: The result panel is appended only after the snapshot; it is not present while captured CLS/LCP values are computed.

initialAssetInventory.method: Existing static JS inventory plus freshly measured gzip of every actual initial stylesheet linked by the seven audited static HTML documents. This is not measured browser transfer.

javaScript.explanation: The two shared ReactDOM and Next/React runtime files alone total 131615 gzip bytes in this exact build. The 80000-byte target is not satisfied. This is a measured current-build floor, not a universal minimum for all Next/React implementations.
javaScript.htmlTradeoff: Locale-only client copy moves selected text into serialized HTML/RSC props. TR homepage HTML gzip changed from 9089 to 11394 bytes; the 4400-byte JS reduction is not an identical total-network saving.

css.deferredCssNote: The Lenis stylesheet is absent from initial HTML link inventory. When loaded during the native sample window, it is included in runtime totals and deferredCss categories.

limitations: Unthrottled localhost timing is not a Lighthouse score, field Core Web Vitals assessment, or real-device acceptance.
No controlled cold-cache/warm-cache split and no explicit network or CPU throttling.
Only homepage initial-load windows are sampled; later scrolling, menus, all product routes, video playback and interactive INP require separate verification.
Desktop motion JavaScript that loads within the window is counted; zero initial desktop canvas means the product world was offscreen, not that desktop motion was disabled.
The 80 KB initial JavaScript gzip target remains unmet.
Runtime functional and visual acceptance evidence is documented separately by the project lead.
